verdict.rationale: Slate has a dedicated Skills doc page. It describes skills as markdown instruction packages that give the agent domain-specific knowledge and behavior, shows an example skill with a frontmatter description, and documents skill directories including `.claude/skills/` for Claude Code compatibility. This directly covers equipping the agent with custom skills for specialized tasks. Missing for 10: detail on how skills are discovered and invoked at runtime, and independent or hands-on corroboration that custom skills work as documented.
